steps.sql: CREATE TABLE p0_numeric_branches (id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, n INT, big BIGINT, required INT NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB
INSERT INTO p0_numeric_branches (id, n, big, required) VALUES (1, 10, 100, 7), (2, 20, 200, 8)
SELECT id, CASE WHEN n > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS one_or_zero FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
SELECT CASE WHEN n > 15 THEN 100 ELSE -5 END AS wider FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
SELECT CASE WHEN n > 15 THEN n ELSE 0 END AS column_branch FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
SELECT CASE WHEN n > 15 THEN 1 END AS no_else FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
SELECT CASE WHEN n > 15 THEN required ELSE 0 END AS never_null FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
SELECT IF(n > 15, 1, 0) AS iffy FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
SELECT IF(n > 15, n, big) AS if_columns FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
UPDATE p0_numeric_branches SET n = CASE WHEN n > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE id = 2
SELECT id, n FROM p0_numeric_branches ORDER BY id
